name: API Layer
description: Flask blueprints exposing HTTP routes for playlists, users, songs, and the friends activity feed, translating requests into service calls.

name: Service Layer
description: Business logic modules for playlists, listening streaks, notifications, song search, and the activity feed that sit between the routes and the ORM models.

name: App Core & Data Model
description: The Flask application factory, SQLAlchemy ORM models, and the seed script that every service and test depends on for database access.

name: Test Layer
description: Pytest suites covering the playlist, streak, and search services against the app and models.

name: Project Meta
description: Project-level documentation and configuration, including the bug-hunt README, Python dependency manifest, and the codebase-analysis tool's ignore rules.
